book.name: 1Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Yerusalaamen Ammano Gaason Waayettizaytas Miishsha Keso
Ha7i qasse ammanizaytas miishsha keso gishshas Galatiyan diza Woosa Keeththatas tani immida azazo mala intteka ooththite.
Miishshay kezanay buro ta hee biin gidontta mala inttefe issi issi asi baas diza mala saaminttan saaminttan wogga gallas kessi woththo.
Ta hee biza wode intte doorida asatas ta moyzo dabdaabe xaafa immada, istti intte immida imotaa Yerusalaame gaththana mala haappe ta kiittana.
Ta isttara baanaas koshshizaaz gidikko tanara bandettes.
Oge Baanaas Phawuloosa Qofa
Tani bashe Maqidooniyara aadhdha buussi taas attontta gishshas ta Maqidooniya gakkada heera intteko baana.

Ta awakka bishin tana ogey waayisontta mala intte tana maaddana mala bashe ta intte achchan gam7ontta aggike. Oonee erizay balgoy aadhdhana gakkanaas ta intte achchan balgoza aaththontta waaya aggana.
Ta intte achchan daro wode gam7anaas koyza gishshas inttena coo ogera aadhdha bashe beyanaas koykke; Godaa shene gidikko intte achchan adussa wode gam7anaas koyays.
Gido attiin Phenxeqoste geetettiza ba7aale gallas gakkanaas ta Efesoonen gam7ana.
Ta heen gam7ana gaasoykka taas heen gita ooso pengey doyettides shin tanara eqettizayti daroti deettes.
Ximtoosi intteko biikko izi ta mala Godaa oosanchcha gidida gishshas izi baboy baynda daana mala intte iza maaddite.
Hessa gishshas oonikka iza kadhoppo; izi taakko saron simmana mala intte iza maaddite; nunikka hara ammanizaytara iza yuussaa naagon doos.
Nu isha Aphiloosi hara ammanizaytara intteko baana mala keeha woossadis shin izi qasse ha7i intteko baanaas koyibeenna; gido attiin baana ogey izas giigshin izi intteko baana.
Wurseththa Zorenne Saroka
Beeggite! Ammanon minni eqqite; minnite; goobite.
Intte ooththizaaz wursika siiqon ooththite.
Ta ishatoo! Akaya biittan koyro ammaniday Isttifaanoseso asaa gididayssanne ammaniza asaa maaddanaas istti bana aaththi immidayssa intteka ereeta.
Istta misatiza asatassinne isttara issife daaburza asatas ubbaas azazettana mala ta inttena woossays.
Isttifaanosi, Ferdonaxoosinne Akayqoosi yida gishshas ta daro ufayettays; gaasoykka intte haan tanara dontta gishshas istti taas paccizaaz wursi kunththida.
Ta wozinanne intte wozina wursi shempisida; hessa gishshas hessantta mala asata mule balopite.
Iisiya biittan diza Woosa Keeththati inttena saro geettes; Aqilaynne Phirsiqillayka istta soon shiiqiza ammaniza asay Godaa sunththan bonchcho sarota inttes shiishsheettes.
Haan ammanizayti wurikka inttena saro geettes; intte intte giddon issoy issaara siiqo yeereteth yeerettite.
Hayssa sarokaa ta kushera xaafiday tana Phawuloosa.
Godaa dosonttaadey diikko izi qanggettidaade gido! Godoo haa ya!
Godaa Yesusa kiyateththi inttenara gido.
Ta siiqoy Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa baggara inttes ubbaas gido! Amiin.
